sections.heading: 8. RETURNS, REPLACEMENT AND TITLE.
sections.content: Goldsikka does not take title to returned items until the item arrives at our designated address. For more information about our returns and replacement, please see our Replacement Policy.

sections.heading: 9. Refund Policy.
sections.content: Once physical position process is started it cannot be reverted back but the trade can be squared up by repurchase. Goldsikka will repurchase Gold / Silver at market momentum rate. Customer can Refund their Gold from Goldsikka at any time. Transaction charges are applicable. If the customer wants to cancel his transaction within 24 hours a transaction fee will be collected and remaning amount will be transfered to his/her bank account.

sections.heading: 10. Delivery Policy.
sections.content:
Gold or Silver Delivery will be in your Town/City with Registered and Recognized Jeweller or Bullion trader in quality and quantity verified tamper proof pack.
1. Delivery of your purchased Gold/Silver - Bullion will be done at notified Jeweller/Bullion Trader in your city/town, the customer kindly need to verify and satisfy with the product in terms of quantity and quality.
2. Goldsikka do not provide home delivery for its customers for security reasons.
3. Customer can collect their Gold/Silver at our registered partners.
4. At the time of delivery customer has to provide Id proof.
